headline: New Mechanism to Automate Customs Duty Pre-Payment in Iraq | Iraq Business News
summary: An implementation mechanism for pre-collecting customs duties has been finalised in Iraq under Cabinet Decision No. 413 of 2026. Finance Minister Faleh Sari chaired the meeting attended by the central bank governor and customs authority.
why: Customs duties are a key source of government revenue and affect import costs. Changes in collection procedures influence trade flows and public finances.
